note: Each step ran on one core of a 2-core sandbox, two steps at a time. Per-step times are from the run_all.py logs; accuracy_sa is the sum of its Garage 1 sweep lines and the separate Garage 2 run. Long steps were interrupted by sandbox time limits and resumed. Fourteen steps (compare_g1/g2, extract_g1/g2, validate_g1/g2, crb, second_root, ci_sensitivity, accuracy_strict_g1, accuracy_strict_g1_ext, rssi_grid, accuracy_p95_g2) were run a second time from scratch and gave identical result files.
